Super Mario's Wacky Worlds.name: Super Mario's Wacky Worlds
Super Mario's Wacky Worlds.summary: Super Mario's Wacky Worlds is a cancelled Mario platform video game in development by NovaLogic for the Philips CD-i system. The game was designed to be a sequel to Super Mario World. While an early prototype of the game received positive feedback from Nintendo, the game was cancelled due to the declining sales of the Philips CD-i system.
